description: Real injection attempts captured from the Moltbook AI agent platform (Feb 2026). These are actual payloads sent by AI agents to other AI agents in the wild — not synthetic. Full dataset (4,209 injections) available at: https://huggingface.co/datasets/DavidTKeane/moltbook-ai-injection-dataset
source: DavidTKeane/moltbook-ai-injection-dataset — 47,735 items scraped, 4,209 injections found (18.85% rate). CC-BY-4.0. David Keane (x24228257), NCI MSc Cybersecurity 2026.
